strings.all_tasks_empty_description: Create a list and start adding tasks.
strings.already_have_account_sign_in: Already have an account? Sign in
strings.api_key_copy_warning: Copy it now, for your security, it won't be shown again.
strings.api_keys_description: Generate a personal API key to call the full OrangTask API directly (read/write lists, tasks, tags) from scripts or tools that need more than the one-way incoming webhook below. Keys don't expire like a login session, revoke one any time it's no longer needed.
strings.assigned_empty_description: Tasks that teammates assign to you in shared lists will show up here.
strings.captcha_create_account_error: Complete the security check to create your account
strings.captcha_security_check_incomplete: Complete the Google reCAPTCHA security check before continuing.
strings.could_not_read_keep_zip: Could not read that file. Select the .zip from Google Takeout (don't unzip it).
strings.delete_account_description: Permanently delete your account and all data. This cannot be undone.
strings.email_security_code_message: Enter the 6-digit security code we sent to %1$s.
strings.email_verified_sign_in: Email verified. Sign in to continue.
strings.export_data_description: Download all your lists, tasks, tags, and webhooks as JSON.
strings.import_google_keep_description: Export your notes with Google Takeout (takeout.google.com), then choose the .zip it gives you, no need to unzip. Checklists become subtasks and labels become tags.
strings.incoming_webhook_description: An incoming URL will be generated. POST a JSON task to it to create tasks from external tools.
strings.just_you_invite_collaborate: Just you for now. Invite someone to collaborate.
strings.language_hint: Translations update automatically when new versions are published.
strings.language_subtitle: Choose the language used by OrangTask
strings.leave_list_confirmation: Leave "%1$s"? You'll lose access until you're invited again.
strings.list_empty_description: Add your first task using the box below.
strings.list_shared_description: When someone shares a list with you
strings.login_footer: Free and open source. Self-host it yourself.
strings.name: Name
strings.no_google_keep_notes: No Google Keep notes found in that zip. Pick the Takeout archive that contains a "Keep" folder.
strings.no_lists_description: Tap "%1$s" above to create your first list, then add tasks.
strings.notification_delivery_description: Push delivers to devices where you've enabled it (browser push today, native Android push arrives in a later update). Email goes to your account address.
strings.notifications_caught_up: You're all caught up. New activity will show here.
strings.oauth_generic: Couldn't sign in with that provider. Please try again.
strings.oauth_link_in_use: That provider is already linked to another account.
strings.oauth_no_email: That account has no verified email to sign in with.
strings.oauth_state: Sign-in expired or was interrupted. Please try again.
strings.overdue_empty_description: Great work staying on top of things.
strings.password_min_length_error: Password must be at least 8 characters
strings.paste_magic_link_error: Paste the link from your email
strings.pin_description: Optional. Require a 4-6 digit PIN to open the app on this account.
strings.pin_reset_message: We emailed a reset code to your account address.

strings.reset_password_request_message: Enter your email and we’ll send you a 6-digit code to reset your password.
strings.revoke_api_key_confirmation: Revoke "%1$s"? Any integration using it will stop working.
strings.session_tokens_missing: The server didn't return session tokens, it's running an older OrangTask backend without native app support. Update and restart the backend, then try again.
strings.sign_in_link_sent: We sent a sign-in link to %1$s
strings.six_digit_code_error: Enter the 6-digit code from your email
strings.task_assigned_description: When someone assigns you a task
strings.task_completed_description: When a collaborator completes a shared task
strings.task_due_soon_description: 1 hour before a task is due

strings.webhooks_description: Send task events to external services, or create tasks from incoming requests.
strings.webhooks_integrations_description: OrangTask works with any tool that can send or receive HTTP requests. Create a webhook in the Webhooks section, then wire it up with n8n, Zapier, or a GitHub Actions curl step.
